page.overview:
Who is Bolla Ropal?

Bolla Ropal was a male Rodian who served as a Jedi Master in the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

When he was a Jedi Initiate, Bolla Ropal had a favorite spoon that the other younglings constantly stole from him as a game. After Ropal and his fellows moved up to the rank of Padawans, the spoon ended up in Obi-Wan Kenobi's possession. Another time, Kenobi swapped out Ropal's wash cream for Naboo glitterpaste. According to Kenobi, Ropal shimmered for days. Another time as a youngling, Bolla attempted to slice a piece of cheese to see if the cheese would toast. Unfortunately, it did not; the experiment ended in a mess. When Ropal was assigned to a Jedi Master, he spent extensive time in the Jedi Archives researching holocrons. Ropal was having a meal with his fellow Padawans when a baby demon squid hidden in Kenobi's soup attacked Kenobi. As Kenobi panicked, Ropal burst out in laughter as his prank succeeded. Confronted by Kenobi, Ropal explained that he had antidote for the venom and Kenobi was never in any real danger. He continued to laugh as Kenobi left with his master, Qui-Gon Jinn, to go meditate. Later that day, Ropal was walking through the Jedi Temple when he almost collided with Count Dooku who was visiting the Temple. The Rodian returned to the Padawan dining hall where he met with Prie, Siri Tachi, and several other Padawans. When Kenobi arrived, Ropal brought up the rumor that Jinn might leave the Jedi Order which upset Kenobi. Ropal followed Kenobi out into the hall and let him know that Jinn hadn't chosen Kenobi as a Padawan but took him on as requested by Master Yoda. He explained that no one would hold it against Kenobi if his Master left the Order.

Ropal acted as the keeper of the Kyber memory crystal during the war, a crystal which contained data on the identities of Force-sensitive children across the galaxy. After bounty hunter Cad Bane stole the holocron containing the crystal from the Jedi Temple on the planet Coruscant, he captured Ropal on the planet Devaron and then tortured him in an attempt to force the Rodian to open the holocron. Ropal refused and died during the torture, although Bane later managed to force the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker to open the holocron.

Bolla Ropal was a male Rodian Jedi Master, who was 1.75 meters (5 feet, 9 inches) tall. He had blue eyes and green skin. Ropal was very curious and mischievous. He liked to pull pranks on his fellow Padawans and was never happier than when he was examining a holocron. During the Clone War, he served as the guardian of a kyber memory crystal. After Cad Bane stole both the crystal and the holocron, Ropal was resistant to Bane's torturous threats in an attempt to force the Jedi to unlock the holocron. The Jedi sacrificed himself in hopes that Bane would be unable to learn the holocron's secrets.
